[[File:LosSantosCivillianDefenceForce-GTASA-banner.png|thumb|right|333px|The banner of the Los Santos Civillian Defence Force.]]
The '''Los Santos Civillian Defence Force''' is, as the name states, the civillian defence force of [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]]. Their goals are security, freedom, democracy and family. Their logo is two [[M16]] assault rifles crossed over a red crosshair. LSCDF banners can be found in [[Ammu-Nation]] stores around [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]]. They may be a paramilitary vigilante group, possibly created by civilians to combat street gangs and cartels, which may be a reference to real-life paramilitary vigilante groups which were created in the early 1990s such as [[:wp:Los Pepes|Los Pepes]].
